source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.11.1, printed page 316.

items: Continuous emission monitoring systems (CEMS) sanati jagahon par CO, O3, SO2, NO2, VOCs aur PM jaisi gases monitor karte hain.
Air quality monitoring stations (AQMS): sensors aur analysers wale muqarrar stations jo real time mein pollutant ke darje napte hain, shehri ilaqon aur sanati zones mein.
Remote sensing: sensors wale satellites bare ilaqon par fizai pollutants napte hain, ilaqai aur aalmi hawa ke mayar ka data dete hue.

blocks.prompt: AQI nizam kis qism ka data deta hai, aur yeh kaise jama hota hai (exercise Q.2h)?
blocks.explanation: PM, NO2, SO2, CO, ozone aur VOCs ki real-time aur ausat concentrations, jo kisi jagah aur waqt ke liye index aur us ki rang patti mein badli jati hain; data zameen par muqarrar monitoring stations aur musalsal emission monitors se aur wasee ilaqon ke liye satellite sensors se aata hai.

items: Sanati jagahon par CEMS; shehron mein AQMS muqarrar stations; ilaqon par satellite remote sensing.
